mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_submission (user_id, request_key, payload_hash, completed) VALUES (#{userId}, #{key}, #{hash}, FALSE) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_key = request_key
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash AS payloadHash, completed FROM health_submission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE health_submission SET completed = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{key}
